summary: First Tracks Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement, dated October 15, 2026, with third-party investors for a private placement of 6,106,870 common shares at $32.75 per share, about $200 million gross proceeds before placement agent fees. Closing expected October 19, 2026, subject to customary conditions, with a registration rights agreement requiring a resale registration statement filing within 30 days post-close. This is a financing rather than a return of capital; the nearest special-situations bucket is ambiguous. Watch resale-registration timing and any share overhang pressure.
